Select compound_chembl_id (molecule_dictionary.chembl_id), canonical_smiles (compound_structures.canonical_smiles), compound_key (compound_records.compound_key), pubmed_id_or_doi (prefer docs.pubmed_id, fallback to docs.doi), assay_description (assays.description), standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id (target_dictionary.chembl_id), target_name (target_dictionary.pref_name), target_organism (target_dictionary.organism). Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, activities to assays on assay_id, assays to target_dictionary on tid, activities to compound_records on record_id, compound_records to docs on doc_id, molecule_dictionary to compound_structures on molregno (INNER JOIN). Filter target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL289', activities.standard_type = 'IC50', compound_structures.canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL, and at least one of docs.pubmed_id or docs.doi IS NOT NULL. Return all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
